explanation: trapdoorLaw is Trapdoor.preimage, i.e. sampleOptList of the lnk column coset Gaussians mapped to a matrix. On the support the column list has length lnk (support_sampleOptList), so a long column of the matrix is a long element of the list; the union bound ev_sampleOptList_exists with the per-column tail cosetGauss_tail (3 * 2^{-M'} under smoothness) gives lnk * 3 * 2^{-M'}.
